title: Create a plugin
prompt: Package a skill, specialist agent, hook, and MCP configuration into a reusable local plugin.
scope: Create owned skills or plugins, inspect actual native discovery and control responses, then invoke the relevant skill through a real model in live mode.

modes.label: Local native discovery and controls
modes.description: Actual SDK operations with zero model turns. This does not certify the live model scenario.

modes.label: Live model scenario
modes.description: Actual model calls with bounded turns, cost and time. Requires locally configured replacement credentials and uses account credits.
